verdict: Paid ads have been off for 22 days; restarting this week.
narrative: Meta ads ran for only the first 7 days of this 28-day period, generating all 6 paid leads before going dark on September 15th — the remaining 22 days produced no paid activity. Organic visibility is also softening: Google Business Profile actions fell nearly 18% week-over-week and search clicks dropped 18% in the same span, so fewer people are finding you without paid support either. Ads are being reactivated this week, and the contact tracking discrepancy (your CRM shows 13 opportunities against 6 attributed leads) is being resolved so the pipeline picture is clean going forward. With ads back on, you should see lead volume recover in the next reporting window.
